proposals.old: Run the reproduction and relevant surrounding tests to show the fix holds.
proposals.new: Run the reproduction and relevant surrounding tests to show the fix holds. Before marking this step complete, inspect the final changes for unintended behavior, compatibility or preservation risks, and unrelated edits. Use a diff when available, or compare the final artifacts with the original source and contract. Record the check results and review findings; distinguish unavailable checks from passing checks.
proposals.observed_failure: Regression tests passed, but the worker proceeded directly to closure without an evidenced substantive final-artifact review.
proposals.predicted_benefit: Adds the missing final-review obligation while accepting substantive Git-free comparisons and tying step completion to observed results.
proposals.risks: May duplicate information already established by focused tests. A brief review of the actual changes should suffice; extra commands or repeated narration are unnecessary.
proposals.transfer_example: For a configuration parsing fix, rerun the reproduction and adjacent checks, then compare the changed parser and defaults against their original behavior before closing verification.

proposals.old: Improve clarity or structure only while keeping the new verification green.
proposals.new: Review the implemented slice against the acceptance criteria, compatibility constraints, and intended scope. Make only justified clarity or structural improvements, keeping the new verification green and rerunning affected checks after any edit. If no refinement is warranted, record a brief evidence-based no-op conclusion rather than making an unnecessary change. Before marking this step complete, record the review findings and verification results, including any unavailable checks.
proposals.observed_failure: The worker checked refinement complete after passing tests and an unavailable Git check, without an evidenced refinement assessment, substantive artifact review, or justified no-op conclusion.
proposals.predicted_benefit: Makes refinement a substantive review rather than a box to check, while explicitly permitting a justified no-op and avoiding forced restructuring.
proposals.risks: Can overlap with final validation. Keep this step focused on design, scope, and any refinement changes; reuse already observed results when the artifact has not changed.
proposals.transfer_example: After adding an optional output mode, review its default compatibility and boundary handling, retain the simple implementation if warranted, and rerun affected checks only if refinement changes it.

proposals.old: Summarize the conclusion, evidence, uncertainty, and suggested next steps. Confirm no files were modified.
proposals.new: Deliver a bounded report stating the conclusion, auditable evidence, remaining uncertainty, and suggested next steps. Confirm workspace preservation from the actions taken and available evidence. Mark this step complete only after that report has been delivered; a completion check is not a substitute for the report.
proposals.observed_failure: The report step was marked complete before the findings, uncertainty, next action, and preservation confirmation were delivered.
proposals.predicted_benefit: Aligns workflow closure with an existing substantive deliverable rather than a promise to provide one.
proposals.risks: Some interfaces request another final response after workflow completion. Reuse the delivered report or provide a short closing reference rather than duplicating the full investigation.
proposals.transfer_example: In a read-only incident diagnosis, deliver the cited causal explanation and unresolved operational checks before marking reporting complete.
